limitations: This is a separate audit pass by the data author, not an independent author or a blind holdout.
Static source review is not dynamic model/gradient/evaluator validation.
Byte-matched label pairs differ by one or three BPE tokens; no token-length causal claim.
Positive/negative marker contrast can solve this narrow task; no general language claim.
Classes1/2 probes are historical TRAIN and may have zero baseline exact accuracy; zero-to-zero does not demonstrate preserved competence.
Current generation probes are newly authored open DEV probes, not the historical full capacity benchmark.
Data hashes are checked through outer registration/inspect and at exit; no atomic defense against concurrent file replacement is established.
